Write a while loop implementing BFGS quasi-Newton optimisation on the Rosenbrock function.

```falcon
local x_bfgs = [0, 0]
local lr_bfgs = 0.001
local iters_bfgs = 10000
func rosenbrock(x) =
  {
    (1 - x[1]) ^ 2 + (100 * (x[2] - x[1] ^ 2)) ^ 2
  }

func rosenGrad(x) =
  {
    local g1 = -2 * (1 - x[1]) - 400 * x[1] * (x[2] - x[1] ^ 2)
    local g2 = 200 * (x[2] - x[1] ^ 2)
    local listResult = [g1, g2]
    listResult
  }

local H_inv = [[1, 0], [0, 1]]
local iter_b = 0
while (iter_b < iters_bfgs) {
  local g = rosenGrad(x_bfgs)
  local p = [-(H_inv[1][1] * g[1] + H_inv[1][2] * g[2]), -(H_inv[2][1] * g[1] + H_inv[2][2] * g[2])]
  local alpha = lr_bfgs
  local x_new = [x_bfgs[1] + alpha * p[1], x_bfgs[2] + alpha * p[2]]
  local g_new = rosenGrad(x_new)
  local s = [x_new[1] - x_bfgs[1], x_new[2] - x_bfgs[2]]
  local y = [g_new[1] - g[1], g_new[2] - g[2]]
  local sy = s[1] * y[1] + s[2] * y[2]
  if (abs(sy) > 0.0000000001) {
    local rho = 1 / sy
    local Hy = [H_inv[1][1] * y[1] + H_inv[1][2] * y[2], H_inv[2][1] * y[1] + H_inv[2][2] * y[2]]
    local yHy = y[1] * Hy[1] + y[2] * Hy[2]
    H_inv[1][1] = H_inv[1][1] - rho * (s[1] * Hy[1] + Hy[1] * s[1]) + rho * (rho * yHy + 1) * s[1] * s[1]
    H_inv[1][2] = H_inv[1][2] - rho * (s[1] * Hy[2] + Hy[1] * s[2]) + rho * (rho * yHy + 1) * s[1] * s[2]
    H_inv[2][1] = H_inv[2][1] - rho * (s[2] * Hy[1] + Hy[2] * s[1]) + rho * (rho * yHy + 1) * s[2] * s[1]
    H_inv[2][2] = H_inv[2][2] - rho * (s[2] * Hy[2] + Hy[2] * s[2]) + rho * (rho * yHy + 1) * s[2] * s[2]
  }
  x_bfgs = x_new
  iter_b = iter_b + 1
}
println("BFGS result: " _ x_bfgs _ " f=" _ rosenbrock(x_bfgs))
```

```falcon
func correlationCoeff(x, y) =
  {
    local n = x.listLen()
    local mx = x
      .reduce(0) { v, s -> v + s } / n
    local my = y
      .reduce(0) { v, s -> v + s } / n
    local num = 0
    local dx2 = 0
    local dy2 = 0
    for (i: 1 .. n step 1) {
      num = num + (x[i] - mx) * (y[i] - my)
      dx2 = dx2 + (x[i] - mx) ^ 2
      dy2 = dy2 + (y[i] - my) ^ 2
    }
    num / sqrt(dx2 * dy2)
  }

println(correlationCoeff([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], [2, 4, 5, 4, 5]))
```

```falcon
func flocking(birds, dt) =
  {
    local result = copyList(birds)
    for (stepVar: 1 .. 3 step 1) {
      local updated = []
      for (i: 1 .. result.listLen() step 1) {
        local b = result[i]
        local sepX = 0
        local sepY = 0
        local avgVx = 0
        local avgVy = 0
        local avgX = 0
        local avgY = 0
        for (j: 1 .. result.listLen() step 1) {
          if (i != j) {
            local o = result[j]
            local dx = b.get("x", 0) - o.get("x", 0)
            local dy = b.get("y", 0) - o.get("y", 0)
            local d = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)
            if (d < 2 && d > 0) {
              sepX = sepX + dx / d
              sepY = sepY + dy / d
            }
            avgVx = avgVx + o.get("vx", 0)
            avgVy = avgVy + o.get("vy", 0)
            avgX = avgX + o.get("x", 0)
            avgY = avgY + o.get("y", 0)
          }
        }
        local n = result.listLen() - 1
        local nvx = b.get("vx", 0) + 0.1 * sepX + 0.05 * (avgVx / n - b.get("vx", 0)) + 0.01 * (avgX / n - b.get("x", 0))
        local nvy = b.get("vy", 0) + 0.1 * sepY + 0.05 * (avgVy / n - b.get("vy", 0)) + 0.01 * (avgY / n - b.get("y", 0))
        local b2 = copyDict(b)
        b2.set("x", b.get("x", 0) + nvx * dt)
        b2.set("y", b.get("y", 0) + nvy * dt)
        b2.set("vx", nvx)
        b2.set("vy", nvy)
        updated.add(b2)
      }
      result = updated
    }
    result
  }
```

```falcon
func resolveCollisions(entities) =
  {
    local updated = copyList(entities)
    for (i: 1 .. updated.listLen() step 1) {
      for (j: i + 1 .. updated.listLen() step 1) {
        local a = updated[i]
        local b = updated[j]
        local dx = b.get("x", 0) - a.get("x", 0)
        local dy = b.get("y", 0) - a.get("y", 0)
        local dist = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)
        local minDist = a.get("r", 0) + b.get("r", 0)
        if (dist < minDist && dist > 0) {
          local overlap = (minDist - dist) / 2
          local nx = dx / dist
          local ny = dy / dist
          local a2 = copyDict(a)
          local b2 = copyDict(b)
          a2.set("x", a.get("x", 0) - nx * overlap)
          a2.set("y", a.get("y", 0) - ny * overlap)
          b2.set("x", b.get("x", 0) + nx * overlap)
          b2.set("y", b.get("y", 0) + ny * overlap)
          updated[i] = a2
          updated[j] = b2
        }
      }
    }
    updated
  }
```

```falcon
func linearRegression(x, y) =
  {
    local n = x.listLen()
    local mx = x
      .reduce(0) { v, s -> v + s } / n
    local my = y
      .reduce(0) { v, s -> v + s } / n
    local num = 0
    local den = 0
    for (i: 1 .. n step 1) {
      num = num + (x[i] - mx) * (y[i] - my)
      den = den + (x[i] - mx) ^ 2
    }
    local slope = num / den
    local intercept = my - slope * mx
    local listResult = [formatDecimal(slope, 2), formatDecimal(intercept, 2)]
    listResult
  }
```
